responsibility: Implements tree-SSA copy propagation and the supporting replacement machinery for propagating SSA names and invariants safely through GIMPLE. Using the generic SSA propagation engine, it tracks a copy-of lattice for SSA names, discovers copy-generating assignments and PHIs, propagates representative names/constants through executable edges, preserves points-to and range metadata where possible, and finally performs substitute-and-fold rewriting plus cleanup of now-redundant copy statements.
